data: Amazon delivered a solid fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 12.4% to $716.9 billion from $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit climbed to $360.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $311.7 billion a year earlier, producing a fiscal 2025 gross margin of 50.3%, a level that underscores the growing weight of higher-value services in the mix. Operating income advanced to $80.0 billion in fiscal 2025 from $68.6 billion in fiscal 2024, translating into an operating margin of 11.2% for fiscal 2025. The bottom line was the standout: net income grew 31.1% to $77.7 billion in fiscal 2025 versus $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024, far outpacing top-line growth. Diluted EPS rose to $7.17 in fiscal 2025 from $5.53 in fiscal 2024. We view the widening gap between revenue and earnings growth as evidence of meaningful operating leverage.
